fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run '^Test(NewCtx|CtxFromEnv|ShellWithStdin|ChildEnv)' and go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run '^Test(ShipGate|ShipPrePush|ShipGenerate|DaemonHook|UsageLive|ChildEnv)' pass, with a new test TestChildEnv in cmd/rhiza that calls run() with an environment whose HOME and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL differ from the process's (set with t.Setenv to other values) and shows the git child sees the given ones (a git config value only that GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL holds is read back), and a test in internal/api that a gate or hook child started through a Ctx whose Environ holds a marker variable the process lacks sees it; failure case: a Ctx whose Environ unsets a variable the process has (PATH-free, or a removed marker) leaves it unset in the child. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-|session-hook|usage-live)' passes; go vet ./cmd/rhiza ./internal/api is clean. Touches cmd/rhiza/main.go, ctx.go, detach_unix.go, tui.go, tui_open.go, internal/api/api.go and the internal/api files named in the statement, and their tests. Must not change any command's output, flags or exit codes.
fields.statement: run() takes its environment as a list, api.Ctx carries it as Environ with Getenv derived from it, and nothing on run()'s call path reads os.Getenv, os.LookupEnv or os.Environ or starts a child with a nil Env (which inherits the process's): gitIn, gitConfig, execIn, shellWithStdin and startProgram's programEnv in cmd/rhiza/ctx.go, detach_unix.go:19, tui.go's colorprofile.Detect calls, and internal/api's ship_build.go:199, usage_live.go:106, daemon_hook.go:87, ship_prepush.go:247, ship_generate.go:104, ship_gate.go:209, run_leaves.go:690, run.go:1657 (XDG_CONFIG_HOME) and project.go:228 (git clone) take it from the Ctx, and gosweep.CacheDir's callers on that path use CacheDirFrom(ctx.Getenv); the daemon's self re-exec (internal/daemon/reexec.go) is the one exception
